title: DeepHLApan: A Deep Learning Approach for Neoantigen Prediction Considering Both HLA-Peptide Binding and Immunogenicity
datasets_used: IEDB benchmark, MS data, pre-existing T-cell response mutations
key_difference: Model paper rather than a contemporaneous reproducibility audit
evidence_note: Primary article provides code and comparisons but uses model-development evaluation rather than a versioned rerun of many aging tools.

title: Benchmarking predictions of MHC class I restricted T cell epitopes in a comprehensively studied model system
key_difference: Strong executable-method benchmark but not human patient-level neoantigen prioritization
evidence_note: Article identified 44 public executable algorithms and ran 15 methods/17 variants, directly motivating a software-aging follow-up.

title: Key Parameters of Tumor Epitope Immunogenicity Revealed Through a Consortium Approach Improve Neoantigen Prediction
key_difference: Prospective consortium comparison but submissions were heterogeneous and largely not rerun from public artifacts
evidence_note: Primary article reports 6 subjects, 25 evaluable teams, 608 tested peptides, 37 immunogenic peptides, AUPRC, fraction-ranked and Top-20 immunogenic fraction.

title: MHCflurry 2.0: Improved Pan-Allele Prediction of MHC Class I-Presented Peptides by Incorporating Antigen Processing
datasets_used: IEDB binding, mass-spectrometry ligands and held-out datasets
key_difference: Presentation-model paper rather than cross-tool patient ranking and installation audit
evidence_note: Paper and official open-source package establish a reproducible presentation baseline suitable for NeoRepro.

title: DeepImmuno: deep learning-empowered prediction and generation of immunogenic peptides for T-cell immunity
datasets_used: IEDB training, 637 tested tumor neoantigens, infectious-disease sets
key_difference: Includes top-20 evaluation but not a broad aging-software audit
evidence_note: Primary article reports top-20/top-50 comparisons on 637 experimentally tested tumor neoantigens and public code/data.

title: Deep neural networks predict class I major histocompatibility complex epitope presentation and transfer learn neoepitope immunogenicity
datasets_used: presentation corpora, neoepitope and infectious-disease immunogenicity benchmarks
key_difference: Modern open model comparison but not patient-bootstrap metric concordance or installation decay
evidence_note: Primary article evaluates BigMHC-IM and seven methods on two independent datasets and releases code, data and weights.

title: Unraveling tumor specific neoantigen immunogenicity prediction: a comprehensive analysis
datasets_used: ITSNdb 199 peptides plus 120-candidate validation scenario and ICB cohorts
key_difference: Closest predictor comparison but patient scenario is partly simulated and installability/version decay are not principal outcomes
evidence_note: Primary article curates 129 positive and 70 negative presented MHC-I neoantigens and evaluates top-10/top-20 prioritization.

title: NeoHunter: Flexible software for systematically detecting neoantigens from sequencing data
key_difference: Patient-wise Top-20 already exists; NeoRepro must focus on independently rerunnable public implementations and common-support fairness
evidence_note: Primary article reports TTIF, fraction-ranked, AUPRC and detection rate by patient against TESLA submissions.

title: pVACview: an interactive visualization tool for efficient neoantigen prioritization and selection
key_difference: Focuses cross-pipeline output harmonization and human review rather than standardized predictive performance
evidence_note: Primary article compares variant-, transcript- and peptide-level output fields across five pipelines and motivates a canonical adapter schema.

title: NeoGuider: neoepitope prediction using advanced feature engineering
key_difference: Recent patient/cohort benchmark narrows performance novelty but does not answer multi-tool installation aging
evidence_note: Primary article reports multi-cohort patient evaluation and public code; overlap and split construction require detailed follow-up.

title: T-SCAPE: T cell immunogenicity scoring via cross-domain aided predictive engine
key_difference: Recent model benchmark but not a public-artifact reproducibility census
evidence_note: Primary article limits benchmark lengths to MHC-I 8-11mers and reports cross-domain model comparison.

title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence for Neoantigen Prediction
key_difference: Current review and benchmark landscape but no executable reproducibility resource
evidence_note: Publisher/PubMed record states that the review includes benchmarking of antigen-presentation predictors for immunogenicity scoring.

title: Cross-task interpretability through unified modeling reveals a universal shortcut bias in neoantigen prediction
models_tested: ImmUni variants and 15 previously evaluated models
datasets_used: BigMHC neoepitope and IEDB infectious-disease benchmarks
key_difference: Directly resolves novelty of discovering HLA-only shortcut bias; NeoRepro should treat it as an audit dimension
evidence_note: Primary article reports an HLA-only model outperforming peptide-HLA models on biased immunogenicity benchmarks.

title: TransNRank: Towards Accurate Neoantigen Ranking with Transformer
key_difference: Directly claims improved Top-20 recall; code availability and split leakage are not yet verified
evidence_note: ArXiv abstract reports Top-20 recall of 53.1% versus a 46.9% prior upper bound; preprint posted 2026-08-03.

title: Automating neoantigen selection for personalized cancer vaccine design
datasets_used: 1943 peptides from 33 patients across 3 clinical trials
key_difference: Predicts expert accept/reject/review decisions rather than experimentally proven immunogenicity
evidence_note: Preprint reports retrospective and prospective patient sets and integration into pVACtools v7; it explicitly states that NEAT does not predict functional T-cell response.

title: pVACtools v6: A comprehensive suite for neoantigen prediction visualization and therapy design
key_difference: Shows current maintained-tool baseline but does not audit historical predictors on one benchmark
evidence_note: ArXiv record documents new presentation, immunogenicity, anchor, similarity and selection features across the suite.

title: mhcmatch public benchmark
key_difference: Highly relevant live repository benchmark but not yet a verified peer-reviewed study
evidence_note: Official repository claims common-task comparisons, bootstrap intervals and TESLA-608 evaluation; treat as exploratory until paper and independent provenance are verified.
